mapper.select:
-- Select partner verification list for paginated operation screens. SELECT pv.id AS verification_id, pv.member_user_id, pv.partner_user_id, pv.business_profile_id, pv.status_code, pv.is_current, pv.is_matching_blocked, pv.submitted_at, pv.verified_at, pv.reviewed_by, pv.review_note, pv.created_at, pv.updated_at FROM partner_verifications pv
ORDER BY pv.created_at DESC, pv.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
-- Count partner verifications for paginated list. SELECT count(1) FROM partner_verifications pv

-- Select partner verification details by primary key. SELECT pv.id AS verification_id, pv.member_user_id, pv.partner_user_id, pv.business_profile_id, pv.status_code, pv.is_current, pv.is_matching_blocked, pv.submitted_at, pv.verified_at, pv.reviewed_by, pv.review_note, pv.created_at, pv.updated_at FROM partner_verifications pv WHERE pv.id = #{verificationId}

-- Select member verification values snapshot. SELECT vmv.birth_year, vmv.address, vmv.region_code, vmv.is_householder, vmv.is_household_member, vmv.health_insurance_basis_code, vmv.has_income FROM verification_member_values vmv WHERE vmv.verification_id = #{verificationId}

-- Select business and financial verification values snapshot. SELECT vbv.annual_revenue, vbv.employee_count, vbv.regular_employee_count, vbv.tax_status_code, vbv.nice_credit_score, vbv.kcb_credit_score, vbv.has_existing_loan, vbv.has_policy_fund_usage, vbv.has_guarantee_usage, vbv.financial_checked_on FROM verification_business_values vbv WHERE vbv.verification_id = #{verificationId}

-- Select family verification value snapshots. SELECT vfv.relation_type_code, vfv.birth_year, vfv.address, vfv.school_age_status_code, vfv.enrollment_status_code, vfv.is_cohabiting, vfv.is_supported, vfv.has_income FROM verification_family_values vfv WHERE vfv.verification_id = #{verificationId} ORDER BY vfv.relation_type_code ASC, vfv.created_at ASC, vfv.id ASC

-- Select verification restriction flags. SELECT vrf.restriction_code, vrf.is_checked, vrf.note FROM verification_restriction_flags vrf WHERE vrf.verification_id = #{verificationId} ORDER BY vrf.restriction_code ASC

-- Select verification document check states. SELECT vd.document_type_code, vd.source_type_code, vd.is_checked, vd.checked_by, vd.checked_at, vd.note FROM verification_documents vd WHERE vd.verification_id = #{verificationId} ORDER BY vd.document_type_code ASC
-- Check user existence by primary key. SELECT count(1) FROM users u WHERE u.id = #{userId}
-- Check business profile existence by primary key. SELECT count(1) FROM business_profiles bp WHERE bp.id = #{businessProfileId}
mapper.update: -- Mark existing current verification as non-current before creating a new one. UPDATE partner_verifications SET is_current = false, updated_by = #{actorUserId}, updated_at = now() WHERE member_user_id = #{memberUserId} AND is_current = true
mapper.insert: -- Insert a draft current partner verification. INSERT INTO partner_verifications ( id, member_user_id, partner_user_id, business_profile_id, status_code, is_current, is_matching_blocked, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{memberUserId}, #{partnerUserId}, #{businessProfileId}, 'DRAFT', true, false, #{actorUserId}, #{actorUserId} )

-- Insert member verification values. INSERT INTO verification_member_values ( verification_id, birth_year, address, region_code, is_householder, is_household_member, health_insurance_basis_code, has_income, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{verificationId}, #{birthYear}, #{address}, #{regionCode}, #{householder}, #{householdMember}, #{healthInsuranceBasisCode}, #{hasIncome}, #{actorUserId}, #{actorUserId} )

-- Insert business and financial verification values. INSERT INTO verification_business_values ( verification_id, annual_revenue, employee_count, regular_employee_count, tax_status_code, nice_credit_score, kcb_credit_score, has_existing_loan, has_policy_fund_usage, has_guarantee_usage, financial_checked_on, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{verificationId}, #{annualRevenue}, #{employeeCount}, #{regularEmployeeCount}, #{taxStatusCode}, #{niceCreditScore}, #{kcbCreditScore}, #{hasExistingLoan}, #{hasPolicyFundUsage}, #{hasGuaranteeUsage}, #{financialCheckedOn}, #{actorUserId}, #{actorUserId} )

-- Insert family verification value. INSERT INTO verification_family_values ( verification_id, relation_type_code, birth_year, address, school_age_status_code, enrollment_status_code, is_cohabiting, is_supported, has_income, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{verificationId}, #{relationTypeCode}, #{birthYear}, #{address}, #{schoolAgeStatusCode}, #{enrollmentStatusCode}, #{cohabiting}, #{supported}, #{hasIncome}, #{actorUserId}, #{actorUserId} )

-- Insert verification restriction flag. INSERT INTO verification_restriction_flags ( verification_id, restriction_code, is_checked, note, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{verificationId}, #{restrictionCode}, #{checked}, #{note}, #{actorUserId}, #{actorUserId} )

-- Insert verification document check state. INSERT INTO verification_documents ( verification_id, document_type_code, source_type_code, is_checked, checked_by, checked_at, note, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{verificationId}, #{documentTypeCode}, #{sourceTypeCode}, #{checked}, CASE WHEN #{checked} = true THEN #{checkedBy} ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN #{checked} = true THEN now() ELSE NULL END, #{note}, #{actorUserId}, #{actorUserId} )
mapper.update: -- Update partner verification status in the approved MVP state flow. UPDATE partner_verifications SET status_code = #{statusCode}, submitted_at = CASE WHEN #{statusCode} = 'SUBMITTED' THEN now() ELSE submitted_at END, verified_at = CASE WHEN #{statusCode} = 'VERIFIED' THEN now() ELSE verified_at END, reviewed_by = CASE WHEN #{statusCode} IN ('VERIFIED', 'REJECTED', 'EXPIRED') THEN #{reviewedBy} ELSE reviewed_by END, review_note = CASE WHEN #{statusCode} IN ('VERIFIED', 'REJECTED', 'EXPIRED') THEN #{reviewNote} ELSE review_note END, updated_by = #{reviewedBy}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{verificationId}
mapper.insert: -- Insert non-PII operation audit log. INSERT INTO audit_logs ( actor_user_id, action_code, resource_type, resource_id, result_code, metadata_json ) VALUES ( #{actorUserId}, #{actionCode}, #{resourceType}, #{resourceId}, #{resultCode}, CAST(#{metadataJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb) )
